versos.hebraico: הֶן־כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ׃

controles.web: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
controles.kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
controles.livre: Eis que meus olhos têm visto tudo isto ; meus ouvidos o ouviram, e entenderam.

versos.hebraico: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־אָ֑נִי לֹא־נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃

controles.web: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
controles.kjv: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
controles.livre: Assim como vós o sabeis, eu também o sei; não sou inferior a vós.

versos.hebraico: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל־שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל־אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃

controles.web: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
controles.kjv: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
controles.livre: Mas eu falarei com o Todo-Poderoso, e quero me defender para com Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

controles.web: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
controles.kjv: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
controles.livre: Pois na verdade vós sois inventores de mentiras; todos vós sois médicos inúteis.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃

controles.web: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
controles.kjv: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
controles.livre: Bom seria se vos calásseis por completo, pois seria sabedoria de vossa parte.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃

controles.web: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
controles.kjv: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
controles.livre: Ouvi agora meu argumento, e prestai atenção aos argumentos de meus lábios.

versos.hebraico: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
controles.kjv: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
controles.livre: Por acaso falareis perversidade por Deus, e por ele falareis engano?

versos.hebraico: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם־לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃

controles.web: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
controles.kjv: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
controles.livre: Fareis acepção de sua pessoa? Brigareis em defesa de Deus?

versos.hebraico: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי־יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
controles.kjv: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
controles.livre: Seria bom para vós se ele vos investigasse? Enganareis a ele como se engana a algum homem?

versos.hebraico: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃

controles.web: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
controles.kjv: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
controles.livre: Certamente ele vos repreenderá, se em oculto fizerdes acepção de pessoas.

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall on you?
controles.kjv: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
controles.livre: Por acaso a majestade dele não vos espantará? E o temor dele não cairá sobre sobre vós?

versos.hebraico: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.
controles.kjv: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
controles.livre: Vossos conceitos são provérbios de cinzas; vossas defesas são como defesas de lama.

versos.hebraico: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃

controles.web: “Be silent, leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
controles.kjv: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
controles.livre: Calai-vos diante de mim, e eu falarei; e venha sobre mim o que vier.

versos.hebraico: עַל־מָ֤ה׀ אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃

controles.web: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
controles.kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
controles.livre: Por que tiraria eu minha carne com meus dentes, e poria minha alma em minha mão?

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי לא אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ־דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל־פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃

controles.web: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
controles.kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
controles.livre: Eis que, ainda que ele me mate, nele esperarei; porém defenderei meus caminhos diante dele.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־הוּא־לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: This also shall be my salvation, that a godless man shall not come before him.
controles.kjv: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
controles.livre: Ele mesmo será minha salvação; pois o hipócrita não virá perante ele.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Hear diligently my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
controles.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
controles.livre: Ouvi com atenção minhas palavras, e com vossos ouvidos minha declaração.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃

controles.web: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
controles.kjv: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
controles.livre: Eis que já tenho preparado minha causa; sei que serei considerado justo.

versos.hebraico: מִי־ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃

controles.web: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
controles.kjv: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
controles.livre: Quem é o que brigará comigo? Pois então eu me calaria e morreria.

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל־תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃

controles.web: “Only don’t do two things to me; then I will not hide myself from your face:
controles.kjv: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
controles.livre: Somente duas coisas não faças comigo; então eu não me esconderei de teu rosto:

versos.hebraico: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃

controles.web: withdraw your hand far from me; and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
controles.kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
controles.livre: Afasta tua mão de sobre mim, e teu terror não me espante.

versos.hebraico: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ־אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you answer me.
controles.kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
controles.livre: Chama, e eu responderei; ou eu falarei, e tu me responde.

versos.hebraico: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
controles.kjv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
controles.livre: Quantas culpas e pecados eu tenho? Faze-me saber minha transgressão e meu pecado.

versos.hebraico: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Why hide you your face, and hold me for your enemy?
controles.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
controles.livre: Por que escondes teu rosto, e me consideras teu inimigo?

versos.hebraico: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת־קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃

controles.web: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
controles.kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
controles.livre: Por acaso quebrarás a folha arrebatada pelo vento ? E perseguirás a palha seca?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃

controles.web: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
controles.kjv: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
controles.livre: Por que escreves contra mim amarguras, e me fazes herdar as transgressões de minha juventude?

versos.hebraico: וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד׀ רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל־אָרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל־שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃

controles.web: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
controles.kjv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
controles.livre: Também pões meus pés no tronco, e observas todos os meus caminhos. Tu pões limites às solas dos meus pés.

versos.hebraico: וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ׃

controles.web: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
controles.kjv: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
controles.livre: Eu  me consumo como a podridão, como uma roupa que a traça rói.
